_doc: UI-test av The Character Creator (tools/studio/ui_test.py, studio/human.js): avdelningen på startsidan, mallarna i lådan, en figur ur reglagen (Man, sedan Weight och Waist), en sparad inpassning med wrap och AI-formen över figuren, ett reglage på inpassningen (wrapen och posen kvar), receptnycklar utan spak (elbow_flex), en figur utan recept (låst), overlay-bilden och Save. Sparar figuren ui_test_creator i assets/characters/; ta bort den efteråt. Kör mot studio-test: url med port 8771.
name: creator

steps.label: the landing page has a card for The Character Creator
the department picker has the Character Creator
the department opens with its Body tab
the drawer lists the ready-made figures
every tile in the drawer has an icon box
the first template is built as a woman on the game mesh with all checks
the Man template builds a taller man on male1591
the Weight slider rebuilds the figure with the new weight
a body slider (Waist) lands under sliders in the recipe
the footer shows the height, triangles and checks
a saved fit opens with its wrap and the wrap switch
the AI shape loads over the figure
the fit's overlay picture opens over the view
a slider on a saved fit rebuilds it with its wrap and pose, not the plain base mesh

steps.eval: (() => { const s = __studio.human.info.saved.find((x) => x.recipe?.elbow_flex != null); if (!s) return 'no saved fit with elbow_flex'; document.querySelector(`#hudrawer .wprof[data-id="saved:${s.name}"]`).click(); return s.name; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const s = __studio.human.info.saved.find((x) => x.recipe?.elbow_flex != null); return !s || (__studio.human.recipe().elbow_flex === s.recipe.elbow_flex && __studio.human.recipe().elbow_carry === s.recipe.elbow_carry); })()
steps.label: recipe keys without a slider here (elbow_flex, elbow_carry) stay in the recipe

steps.eval: (() => { const s = __studio.human.info.saved.find((x) => !x.recipe); if (!s) return 'every saved figure has a recipe'; window.__lockName = s.name; window.__lockBuild = __studio.human.lastBuild?.name; document.querySelector(`#hudrawer .wprof[data-id="saved:${s.name}"]`).click(); return s.name; })()

steps.label: a saved figure without a recipe opens locked, with a note

steps.eval: (() => { if (!window.__lockName) return 'skip'; const r = document.querySelector('#huside .card:not(.hu-keep) input[type=range]'); r.value = 0.8; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); return getComputedStyle(r.closest('.rows')).pointerEvents; })()

steps.label: the locked figure is never rebuilt from the plain base mesh
Save builds the figure under its name, with a thumbnail, and lists it as saved

steps.expect: document.querySelector('#huside a.hu-link')?.href === 'http://192.168.0.17:8790/character' && [...document.querySelectorAll('#huside button')].some((b) => b.textContent === 'Open the Body Editor')
steps.label: the card More tools links to Darrowmere's order page and the Body Editor
